messages:
Maya: quick check  finalizing social push for launch week. core goals: webinar signups, benchmark narrative, and clean SDR routing.
Luca: suggest we do a 4-post cadence: day0 teaser, day2 benchmark deep-dive (thread), day4 webinar push, day6 follow-up + customer quotes. keep copy short on X, longform on LinkedIn.
Priya: I can create a 30s hero clip + 3 carousel frames. need copy variants and final CTAs by tomorrow noon.
Sam: routing notes: all webinar CTAs must append utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=launch_q2 so Zap/webhook can map to the Webinar SDR queue. replies containing exact phrases "Interested demo" or "Book call" should be flagged as high-intent.
Maya: flagging paid boost: one X post targeted to devs, one LinkedIn sponsored to PMs. budget TBD.
Luca: copy sketches:
- Data-led (X): "Latency down 3x, cost per token down 2x. See the optimizations behind production-grade inference. Webinar Thurs 11am PT. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=launch_q2"
- Product-led (LinkedIn): "How teams ship LLM features in days not months. Join our webinar for the checklist + demo. Register: {link}?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=launch_q2"
Priya: thumbs question: thumbnails  graph or UI? graph stops the scroll faster.
Maya: graph for X, UI for LinkedIn. include alt text and 16:9 thumbnails.
SocialBot: schedule preview ready: https://redwood.social/schedule/preview/1738902468  4 X posts, 2 LinkedIn posts, 1 carousel, 2 clips.
Sam: I'll run webhook/sync tests today and paste logs here. also adding tweet_id -> reply mapping to the intake so SDRs have context.
Luca: plan an A/B on the benchmark thread: A = metrics-led, B = dev quickstart with mini code snippet. measure CTR to signup and high-intent replies.
Priya: sharing Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/launch-q2  comments open.
Sam: webhook test passed  sample payload posted to #eng-infra. SDR routing rule created: utm_campaign=launch_q2 -> Webinar SDR queue.
Maya: next steps: Luca finalize copy by 11am PT tomorrow, Priya deliver assets by EOD, Sam verify final webhook mapping, I'll finalize boost targets. sign-off sync 9:30am PT tomorrow. :sparkles:
